newsitem.title: UK: Cluedo inventor sought in mystery whodunnit.
newsitem.headline: Cluedo inventor sought in mystery whodunnit.

text.p: The makers of Cluedo, the mystery whodunnit game that has sold almost 150 million copies around the world, are hunting for its inventor to join in the celebrations.
Lawyer's clerk Anthony Pratt invented the detective board game in 1948. Three million sets are sold every year in 23 countries.
He sold his copyright to the manufacturers Waddingtons, who now are trying to trace him to present him with a trophy to mark the 150 million sales mark.
The firm, which was last in contact with him 10 years ago at the time of the Cluedo world championships, has set up a special hotline for amateur detectives who might track down the elusive Pratt.
